answer: Post-hoc cluster divergence audits score identities after settlement on action mix, counterparties, and recurrence; correlated outliers crossing a zenith threshold are frozen pending review. Enforcement requires flagged clusters to show independent histories, forcing attackers to generate distinct activity per identity rather than one shared tundra of behavior. Any repeated address or client fingerprint acts as a beacon linking identities, and per identity the attacker pays separate discovery, logging, and review-latency costs plus forfeited rewards.
